preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (address 0xBd51b6D98574327734C1621A7283778c5e6Af86e)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable all swap and liquidity functionality. This will stop automatic token swaps and liquidity additions, effectively freezing transaction processing for all users except the owner who remains excluded from fees and restrictions.
